moral.zh: 云由极小水滴或冰晶组成；它们下落很慢，被上升气流托住，还会随风移动。
moral.en: Clouds are tiny water droplets or ice crystals that can be supported by rising air and carried by wind.

pages.enText: Xiao Yu held the kite string and looked up. “Mom, why do clouds float?”
